item.title: Iran War Live Updates: Israeli Airstrikes Shake Beirut and Drone Attacks Hit Tehran
item.summary: The Middle East conflict showed no sign of letup, as Israeli airstrikes hammered the Beirut outskirts, drone attacks spread fear in Iran and three ships were hit near the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: How Trump’s War With Iran Changed the World in a Week
item.summary: The conflict is reshaping travel patterns, energy dependencies, living costs, trade routes and diplomatic alliances.

item.title: Trump Casts a Shadow Over One of Mexico’s Deadliest States
item.summary: President Trump wants to strike cartels inside Mexico. In Sinaloa State, a cartel stronghold, some residents said they were willing to entertain U.S. intervention.

item.title: Iran’s New Supreme Leader Was Wounded Early in the War, Iranian and Israeli Officials Say
item.summary: Officials say Mojtaba Khamenei’s legs were hurt, but the circumstances as well as the extent of his injuries were unclear. He has remained out of view since being announced as leader three days ago.

item.title: Russia Says Ukraine’s Strike on Factory City Was Deadly
item.summary: Ukraine said the attack struck a key electronics plant, highlighting how it remains capable of hitting high-value targets inside Russia.

item.title: World Heritage Sites Hit in Airstrikes on Iran
item.summary: Revered cultural icons that have withstood the upheavals of history are being hit hard in the war being waged by Israel and the United States.

item.title: Will Trump TACO on Iran?
item.summary: It’s a crucial election year and economic and political costs of the war are rising. It won’t be easy for the president to declare victory and walk away.

item.title: First Week of Iran War Cost More Than $11 Billion, Pentagon Tells Congress
item.summary: In a Capitol Hill briefing, officials gave their most comprehensive assessment of the cost of the first six days of the war, but the number omitted several aspects of the operation.

item.title: Banks in Gulf Evacuate Their Offices
item.summary: After an overnight attack on a bank, Iranian officials signaled a new willingness to target economic centers and banks with ties to the United States.

item.title: Lebanese residents are left in shock and fear as Israeli strikes reach the center of Beirut.
